## Checklist

- [ ] The project is live and the URL resolves
- [ ] I added one object to `data/entries.json`, alphabetical within its category
- [ ] The description is one factual sentence, 160 characters or fewer
- [ ] Pricing reflects what the project publishes (`unknown` if it does not)
- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and it passed, and committed the regenerated `README.md`
- [ ] This is a provider or tool, not an individual token
